subject: POC: workload intake & next steps (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: POC: workload intake & next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today, good discussion on the goals for the POC. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can stand up the trial environment this week: 

Summary / success criteria you mentioned
- Primary goal: Validate inference latency & cost for live routing of clinical triage prompts into our assistant.
- Success criteria (customer-proposed): 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for single-turn classification; end-to-end 95th <= 700ms for multi-turn (up to ~1k tokens).
- Accuracy / quality: intent classification F1 >= 0.92 on the evaluation set you'll provide.

POC scope / timeline
- 4-week trial starting as early as Aug 10 (2 weeks ingest + 2 weeks live traffic evaluation).
- Model candidates: open-weight LlamaX-13B / quantized variants. We can propose alternatives if latency/cost targets need adjustments.

Immediate asks for workload intake (can you confirm the items below?)
1) Baseline & peak RPS (avg/95th/peak): e.g., baseline 10 rps, peak bursts up to 120 rps for 30-60s?
2) Typical prompt sizes: average tokens in prompt, average tokens in response, and max expected history length.
3) Concurrency / number of concurrent sessions (streams) hitting the endpoint during peaks.
4) Burst patterns: frequency of bursts (hourly/daily), and any predictable schedules (e.g., mornings 9-11am).
5) A sample of ~200 anonymized prompts & expected outputs for quality eval (CSV).
6) Any regulatory constraints (data residency/KMS) we should account for.

Attachments: I've attached a lightweight intake template (workload_profile.xlsx): fill the highlighted fields and send back when you have 1-2 hours.

Marissa (cc), can you scope the test harness and confirm what we need from their side for logs and evaluation?
Dev, I'll loop you on the procurement / SOW once we lock dates.

Next steps
- Alice: confirm the workload numbers + attach sample prompts (by EOD Tue Aug 4 if possible)
- Redwood: Marissa to propose test plan and resource slate by Wed Aug 5; Ben to send draft SOW.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Prompt sizes

Other notes
- We can provide a 200-sample CSV (attached) with anonymized inputs/expected labels for classification.
- Data residency: US only (HIPAA-covered). We will need SOC 2 + an executed DPA; procurement is aware.

POC timing: Aug 10 start works for us. We'd like a short sync with Marissa to walk the sample dataset and logging.

-Alice

Thanks, saw the sample and the numbers look reasonable. Proposed test plan (high level):

1) Environment & infra
- Recommend Redwood Dedicated pool for the POC (single-tenant) due to HIPAA scope and predictable latency. Start with 2 x A10G-equivalent workers (can adjust after initial run).

2) Test harness configuration
- Steady-state: run 8 RPS for 30 min to baseline throughput/latency.
- Stress bursts: replay traffic to simulate spikes up to 140 RPS for 30-60s, repeated 4x with 5 min cool-down.
- Concurrency test: simulate 60 concurrent sessions with the realistic history lengths (mix of 220 avg / some up to 1,200 tokens).
- Token-level accounting: enable prefix caching for repeat prompts to reduce cost on obvious repeats.

3) Metrics / success criteria to collect
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 of request-to-first-byte and request-to-last-byte. Target p95 <= 400ms (single-turn) per Acme ask.
- Quality: run the 200-sample labeled set through the same model & compute F1; target >= 0.92.
- Cost: run projected cost model for observed RPS & token counts and provide per-1M token estimate.

4) Logging & artifacts we need from Acme
- Sample CSV (200 rows) + mapping of expected labels (they attached sample_traffic.csv — need full 200-row file).
- Short-lived access to logs or a forwarding endpoint (we'll provide a log shipper).

5) Ops / runbook
- Run owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (SE)
- Customer lead: Alice Nguyen
- Duration: 4 weeks (2 weeks ingest+baseline + 2 weeks live eval)

I've attached a concise checklist (redwood_poc_checklist.pdf) that we can walk through on the kickoff call.

Questions for Ben / Dev:
- Procurement: will Acme want a trial invoice / one-off committed seat for Dedicated?
- Dev: confirm SLA & DPA path — I'll include the SOC 2 link in the shared folder.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
